mapper.sql: pay50_expense_id AS expense_id, pay50_company_id AS company_id, pay50_expense_cd AS expense_code, pay50_expense_nm AS expense_name, pay50_reg_emp_id AS reg_emp_id, pay50_reg_date AS reg_date, pay50_occ_date AS occ_date, pay50_desc AS "desc", pay50_content AS content, pay50_corp_id AS corp_id, pay50_corp_nm AS corp_name, pay50_tax_type AS tax_type, pay50_tax_type_nm AS tax_type_name, pay50_amt AS amt, COALESCE(pay50_tax, 0) AS tax, pay50_settle_amt AS settle_amt, pay50_due_date AS due_date, pay50_pay_method_cd AS pay_method_code, pay50_pay_method_nm AS pay_method_name, pay50_pay_account_info AS pay_account_info, pay50_confirmer_id AS confirmer_id, pay50_confirm_status_cd AS confirm_status_code, pay50_confirmer_org_nm AS confirmer_org_name, pay50_appr_emp_id AS appr_emp_id, pay50_appr_emp_org_nm AS appr_emp_org_name, pay50_reject_reason AS reject_reason, COALESCE(pay50_reject_sms_yn, 'false') AS reject_sms_yn, pay50_account_cd AS account_code, pay50_account_nm AS account_name, pay50_note AS note, pay50_deposit_id AS deposit_id, pay50_deposit_nm AS deposit_name, pay50_ast_id AS ast_id, pay50_ast_nm AS ast_name, pay50_floral_id AS floral_id, pay50_journal_id AS journal_id, pay50_expense_appr_id AS expense_appr_id, pay50_expense_appr_title AS expense_appr_title, pay50_expense_appr_status_cd AS expense_appr_status_code, pay50_expense_appr_status_nm AS expense_appr_status_name, pay50_reg_emp_org_nm AS reg_emp_org_name, pay50_expense_status_nm AS expense_status_name, pay50_file_count_str AS file_count_str, pay50_org_nm AS org_name
mapper.select: SELECT pay50_expense_id AS expense_id, pay50_company_id AS company_id, pay50_expense_cd AS expense_code, pay50_expense_nm AS expense_name, pay50_reg_emp_id AS reg_emp_id, pay50_reg_emp_org_nm AS reg_emp_org_name, pay50_reg_date AS reg_date, pay50_occ_date AS occ_date, pay50_desc AS "desc", pay50_settle_amt AS settle_amt, pay50_due_date AS due_date, pay50_corp_id AS corp_id, pay50_corp_nm AS corp_name, pay50_floral_id AS floral_id FROM ( ---------------------------------------- -- 사업비요청 ---------------------------------------- SELECT pay50_expense_id , pay50_company_id , pay50_expense_cd , f_cdnm('ExpenseType', pay50_expense_cd, pay50_company_id, pay50_reg_date) AS pay50_expense_nm , pay50_reg_emp_id , f_get_empTrans(pay50_reg_emp_id , pay50_reg_date, 'person_org_info') AS pay50_reg_emp_org_nm , pay50_reg_date , pay50_occ_date , pay50_desc , pay50_settle_amt , pay50_due_date , pay50_corp_id , COALESCE(sys15_corp_nm, f_emp_kor_nm(pay50_corp_id)) AS pay50_corp_nm , null AS pay50_floral_id FROM pay50_expense LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = pay50_corp_id WHERE pay50_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay50_confirm_status_cd = '20' /*(20:승인)*/ AND pay50_appr_emp_id IS NULL ---------------------------------------- -- 화환신청 ---------------------------------------- UNION ALL SELECT row_number() over() AS pay50_expense_id , bbs20_company_id AS pay50_company_id , '20' AS pay50_expense_cd , f_cdnm('ExpenseType', '20', bbs20_company_id, bbs20_reg_date) AS pay50_expense_nm , bbs20_person_id AS pay50_reg_emp_id , f_get_empTrans(bbs20_person_id , bbs20_reg_date, 'person_org_info') AS pay50_reg_emp_org_nm , bbs20_reg_date AS pay50_reg_date , bbs20_end_date AS pay50_occ_date , CONCAT(f_cdnm('OccasionsCode',bbs20_occasions_cd,bbs20_company_id,bbs20_reg_date) ,' - '||bbs20_rcv_company ,' '||bbs20_rcv_emp ,'('||bbs20_reason||')') AS pay50_desc , null AS pay50_settle_amt , null AS pay50_due_date , null AS pay50_corp_id , null AS pay50_corp_nm , bbs20_floral_request_id AS pay50_floral_id FROM bbs20_floral_request WHERE bbs20_company_id = #{companyId} AND bbs20_status_cd = '92' /*(20:접수/92:발송완료)*/ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pay50_expense WHERE pay50_floral_id = bbs20_floral_request_id ) ) t WHERE CONCAT(pay50_reg_emp_org_nm, pay50_expense_nm, pay50_desc, pay50_corp_nm) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY pay50_occ_date DESC

SELECT FROM ( SELECT pay50.* , f_cdnm('ExpenseType' , pay50_expense_cd , pay50_company_id, f_today()) AS pay50_expense_nm , f_cdnm('TaxType' , pay50_tax_type , pay50_company_id, f_today()) AS pay50_tax_type_nm , f_cdnm('PayMethodCode' , pay50_pay_method_cd , pay50_company_id, f_today()) AS pay50_pay_method_nm , f_get_account_nm(pay50_company_id, pay50_account_cd) AS pay50_account_nm , ast1.ast01_class_tree_nm AS pay50_deposit_nm , ast2.ast01_class_tree_nm AS pay50_ast_nm , f_get_empTrans(pay50_reg_emp_id , f_today(), 'person_org_info') AS pay50_reg_emp_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(pay50_appr_emp_id , f_today(), 'person_org_info') AS pay50_appr_emp_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(pay50_confirmer_id , pay50_reg_date, 'person_org_info') AS pay50_confirmer_org_nm , f_get_empTrans(pay50_reg_emp_id , pay50_reg_date, 'org_code_nm') AS pay50_org_nm , COALESCE(sys15_corp_nm, f_emp_kor_nm(pay50_corp_id)) AS pay50_corp_nm , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = pay50_expense_id ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com01_relate_appr WHERE com01_key_table_id = pay50_expense_id ) ||'건' AS pay50_file_count_str , CASE WHEN pay50_appr_emp_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE (CASE WHEN COALESCE(apr1.apr01_status_cd,'99') = '30' THEN '완료' WHEN COALESCE(apr1.apr01_status_cd,'99') = '40' OR COALESCE(pay50_reject_reason,'') != '' THEN '반려' ELSE '진행중' END) END AS pay50_expense_status_nm , apr1.apr01_title AS pay50_expense_appr_title , apr1.apr01_status_cd AS pay50_expense_appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr1.apr01_status_cd, pay50_company_id, f_today()) AS pay50_expense_appr_status_nm FROM pay50_expense pay50 LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = pay50_corp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr1 ON apr1.apr01_appr_id = pay50_expense_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree ast1 ON ast1.ast01_class_tree_id = pay50_deposit_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree ast2 ON ast2.ast01_class_tree_id = pay50_ast_id WHERE pay50_expense_id = #{expenseId} AND pay50_company_id = #{companyId} ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay50_expense ( pay50_expense_id, pay50_company_id, pay50_expense_cd, pay50_reg_emp_id, pay50_reg_date, pay50_occ_date, pay50_desc, pay50_confirmer_id, pay50_confirm_status_cd, pay50_confirm_date, pay50_appr_emp_id, pay50_floral_id, pay50_pay_method_cd ) VALUES ( #{expenseId}, #{companyId}, #{row.expenseCode}, #{row.regEmpId}, #{row.regDate}, #{row.occDate}, #{row.desc}, #{apprEmpId}, '20', #{row.occDate}, #{apprEmpId}, #{row.floralId}, '10' )
mapper.update: UPDATE pay50_expense SET pay50_appr_emp_id = null , pay50_reject_reason = null , pay50_reject_sms_yn = null , pay50_expense_appr_id = null WHERE pay50_expense_id = #{expenseId} AND pay50_company_id = #{companyId}
